command: pre-registration: N46-PG, place phase alone on frozen pi0.5 / GR00T (bottle pre-grasped, held 6 cm above the release point over the target), with scripted servo / open references (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 51)

metrics.arms: experiments/n46_pg.py client. Prefix: the v2 servo's waypoints (pp_n4d.plan_episode servo=True), kp = pp_l1_floor.kp_for(task), rng default_rng(seed_base + 10), reach timeouts 120 (Read G's), phases 0-4 then down to release point + 0.06 m, gripper closed; hand-over at err < .008 or 120 steps (cap 300 prefix steps). vla = frozen model (pp_serve_purify --model M --mode intact --comp= --seed 13) from its next query, task instruction unchanged, server not queried during the prefix; servo = lower to the release point, open 12 steps, up 0.10 m; open = open where it is 12 steps, up 0.10 m. Launcher experiments/n46_pg_roll.sh; client seed 7; --bind track; --max-steps 450.
metrics.interpretation: PLACE PRESENT on a model: its place skill for the bottle on a low movable target exists, so its N4 / N6 residual sits upstream, in which carry program the held bottle selects (routing; with P_min / H as the feasibility reference, an architecture-rooted candidate). PLACE ABSENT: the model cannot put the bottle down on the plate / in the bowl even from 6 cm above, a motor gap no LIBERO-Goal demo covers (data gap as measured). Servo and open give the feasible ceiling and the release-only floor from the same states.
metrics.mapping: experiments/n46_pg.py read as hashed. Per model, arm vla, pooled N4 + N6; unit = episode held (oracle) at the hand-over and not successful before it; placement success; cluster bootstrap over states, B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0), CI 2.5/97.5. PLACE PRESENT iff CI lo >= .40; PLACE ABSENT iff CI hi < .30; else MIXED. Descriptive: per task N4 / N6 / N5 for vla / servo / open; held share (LOW POWER if < .60 on N4 or N6); post-hand-over stage; lift after hand-over; final tilt and nearest entity; vla - open and vla - servo on shared held cells.
metrics.prediction: (after the smoke, which showed pi0.5 vla 8/8, servo 8/8, open 6/8 on states 0-3) pi0.5 PLACE PRESENT 80% (MIXED 15%, ABSENT 5%), point ~.85. GR00T: PLACE PRESENT 35%, MIXED 35%, ABSENT 30%, point ~.45; its failures re-lift (lift after hand-over > .10 m) or never let go. servo >= .80 on N4 and N6; open ~.6-.8 on both (the smoke's floor: release alone nearly suffices from 6 cm, so vla - open is the closer read of any skill beyond releasing). N5 control: pi0.5 >= .7. Held at hand-over >= .80 per task.
metrics.seen: When this was written: SR 46-49 (N4 / N6 per task under every arm), the descriptive phase breakdown of all existing N4 / N6 rollouts (experiments/n46_phase.py, job 4704946, results/flawed/n46_phase.json) and the carry-height split (experiments/n46_lift.py, job 4705215): N4 / N6 failures are post-grasp on pi0.5 and GR00T; pooled over all sets and arms, pi0.5 N4+N6 grasped episodes with a high carry (lift > .22 m, K4's cabinet carry) succeed .04 (n 139) and low carries .66 (n 221); GR00T carries high in 556 of 582 (success .01); the servo carries high and still places (N4 1.00, N6 .77 of grasped); P_min .80 / .80; HAND_OVER 6.1's H (VLA grasp, P_min after) .80-1.00. The front end works on N4 / N6 (detector fires ~1.00, median onset 0 from oracle, paint IoU ~.98). Code is new, so a smoke ran before this row: job 4705214, pi0.5, arms vla / servo / open, N4 and N6, smoke states 0-3 (n2_branches_smoke.json), output outside results/ (.claude_tmp/pp/n46_smoke). Smoke outcomes are in the row's 'smoke' field.
